summary: The main article describes a photoredox-catalyzed synthesis of indole-fused 1,4-diazepinones using aroyl chlorides. The study includes optimization of reaction conditions, scope evaluation with various substituents, scale-up experiments, and kinetic studies to determine rotational barriers of the resulting axially chiral diastereoisomers.
